description: Change the 5G NR mode and enable VoLTE on rooted Pixel phones Unlock the network features your Pixel hides in some countries. In some countries, Pixel only allows 5G SA, and VoLTE or Wi-Fi calling are not available. With root access, this app changes the modem and carrier settings, separately for each SIM. 5G - Change the modem NR mode: SA, NSA, SA+NSA or disabled Calling - VoLTE, VoNR, Wi-Fi calling and video calling - Enhanced 4G LTE mode options - See the IMS registration status of each SIM - Apply changes by restarting the phone service, no reboot needed Status bar - Show 4G instead of LTE - Show the LTE+ icon Hotspot - Set the Wi-Fi country code: US, GB or AU - Apply it on every boot Requirements - Root access (Magisk or KernelSU) - Pixel with Samsung modem (Pixel 6-9) - Android 12 or newer Calling options work like the Pixel IMS Magisk module: they are added to the carrier config of each SIM. If the module is installed, disable it to avoid conflicts.
